record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The units in appliesTo declare RETALIATE in this production reference. The strategy is shared; differences are star count, attack stat, range and passive.
record.summary: Deals 1 + N separate SPECIAL hits to the cast target, where N is the number of fallen allies (the caster team's DPS-meter size minus same-team units still on the board). Each hit has the same raw amount: the caster's current attack stat x 1.5 (1 to 3 stars; 3 at 4+ stars). The hits are separate handleSpecialDamage calls, each scaled by AP and the cast's single crit flag, then reduced by the target's SPE_DEF; there is no area, status or movement. The cast cannot crit unless the caster has ABILITY_CRIT (canCritByDefault false).

targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read. If the target dies during the loop the remaining iterations still call handleSpecialDamage on it (their effect on a dead target was not traced).

effects.scaling: requested per hit = pokemon.atk (the caster's attack at cast time, after buffs and items) x multiplier; then per hit AP: x(1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); the cast's crit flag multiplies each hit by critPower only if the cast rolled a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT); total requested = hits x per-hit requested, before defences
effects.resolution: each of the 1 + N hits is resolved independently: a protect / skydiving / magicBounce target takes none; otherwise the SPE_DEF division (ceil, minimum 1, core-mechanics section A) is applied PER HIT, so the minimum of 1 and the ceil apply to every hit. N = DPS-meter size - allies still on the board, so it counts every entity ever added to the team's meter, not only deaths in the round. The strategy does not read takenDamage.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; 1, 2 and 3 stars share 1.5; the 4-star value (3, also the fallback) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. The raw damage depends on the caster's current atk, which differs per unit and is not a table in the source. maxPP and range are in appliesTo.

record.positionalConditions: None: the strategy reads no coordinates; only the cast target and the fallen-ally count matter.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and recomputes the fallen-ally count and the attack stat.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested per hit: atk x 1.5 (atk read at cast time, not a table value). Number of hits: 1 + fallen allies. Each hit is then scaled by AP [x crit factor] and reduced by the target's SPE_DEF (ceil, minimum 1) separately; the total taken is the sum of the per-hit results.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: The caster's atk at cast time (base stat, synergies, items, buffs) was not traced; atk is read as a plain field of PokemonEntity
